description: Deploy AWS CDK stacks as a Dagster asset.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key for this CDK deployment asset.

working_dir.label: Working Dir
working_dir.description: Filesystem path to the directory containing cdk.json and the CDK app entry point.

stacks.label: Stacks
stacks.description: Specific CDK stack names to deploy. When None all stacks are deployed (equivalent to ``cdk deploy "*"``).

context.label: Context
context.description: CDK context key/value pairs passed as ``-c key=value`` arguments.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.description: CloudFormation parameter overrides in ``StackName:ParameterName=value`` format, passed via ``--parameters``.

require_approval.label: Require Approval
require_approval.description: Approval level for security-sensitive changes. One of "never", "any-change", or "broadening". Use "never" for fully automated runs.

exclusively.label: Exclusively
exclusively.description: Pass ``--exclusively`` to deploy only the listed stacks without deploying their dependency stacks.

hotswap.label: Hotswap
hotswap.description: Pass ``--hotswap`` for faster deployments of Lambda functions and ECS services without a full CloudFormation update. Recommended for development environments only.

rollback.label: Rollback
rollback.description: Pass ``--rollback`` to roll back the stack on deployment failure. Set to False to leave the stack in a failed state for debugging.

outputs_file.label: Outputs File
outputs_file.description: Path where CDK writes stack outputs as JSON via ``--outputs-file``. When None a temporary path under /tmp is used automatically.

profile.label: Profile
profile.description: AWS CLI profile name to use for authentication.

cdk_bin.label: Cdk Bin
cdk_bin.description: Path or name of the CDK CLI executable. Defaults to ``cdk`` which must be available on PATH (installed via ``npm install -g aws-cdk``).

env_vars.label: Env Vars
env_vars.description: Additional environment variables to inject into the CDK subprocess. Merged on top of the current process environment.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

description.label: Description
description.description: Human-readable description surfaced in the Dagster UI.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Dagster asset keys that this asset depends on. Useful when downstream data assets need to declare a dependency on this provisioning asset.

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage, emitted as `dagster/column_lineage` metadata on every materialization: {output column: [upstream columns]}, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}. The upstream asset is `upstream_asset_key`, or the only entry of `deps`; with several upstream assets, name each column '<asset_key>:<column>'. Ignored with a warning when no upstream asset can be resolved.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format (e.g. '2024-01-01'). Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_date_column.description: Not used by this component, which has no input rows to filter. Use {partition_key}, {partition_date}, {partition_start} and {partition_end} in `context` and `parameters` instead.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme,globex,initech'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer'.
partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim

partition_static_column.description: Not used by this component, which has no input rows to filter. Use {partition_key}, {partition_date}, {partition_start} and {partition_end} in `context` and `parameters` instead.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on failure. Defines a RetryPolicy when set.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' fires ONE external call covering the whole backfill range -- the partition_key/partition_start/partition_end tokens this component already supports are comma-joined/range-spanning rather than a single key -- instead of one call per partition. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

name: AWS CDK Asset
